stories.title: London, Ont., police officer charged with assault in off-duty incident
stories.summary: Investigators say the officer’s name and identifying details will not be released to protect the victim’s privacy.

stories.title: Leafs sign defenceman Bilecki to entry-level deal
stories.summary: The Toronto Maple Leafs have signed defenceman Alexander Bilecki to a three-year entry-level contract, the NHL club announced Friday.

stories.title: Ontario calls for Criminal Code changes to give home invasion victims more protection
stories.summary: Ontario is calling on Ottawa to amend federal law to give Canadians stronger protections to confront attackers in their homes after a spate of violent home invasions in Toronto.

stories.title: Stolen smart glasses saved video of suspect’s face on paired device: Police
stories.summary: South Simcoe Police say a man walked into an eyewear store in Cookstown, Ont., on Nov. 11 at around 7:30 p.m. and asked to try on a pair of Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses.

stories.title: Cause of plane crash that killed a teen near Toronto undetermined: TSB
stories.summary: The investigation into the death of a 16-year-old boy after a float plane crash northeast of Toronto provided more answers but it's still not clear what caused the accident.

stories.title: Jury in Jamal Francique inquest deliberating recommendations
stories.summary: The jury heard police secretly surveilled 28-year-old Jamal Francique for days, after receiving a tip that he was trafficking drugs and had a gun.

stories.title: Crown seeks 25-year sentence for Kenneth Law, who admitted to aiding suicide
stories.summary: A sentencing hearing is set to continue Friday for an Ontario man who sold potentially deadly substances online to people who then used those products to take their own lives.

stories.title: Doug Ford advises Ontarians to protect against home invasions by any means
stories.summary: Doug Ford said Thursday he wants to see legal changes to address a spate of home invasions, and in the meantime he advised people to protect their families by any means necessary.

stories.title: Rare three-day break lets Raptors reflect, reset
stories.summary: A rare three-day break, coinciding with American Thanksgiving, gave Scottie Barnes and his Toronto Raptors teammates a chance to pause and maybe reset after a disappointing start to the season.

stories.title: Parts of Ontario under freezing rain special advisory
stories.summary: Environment Canada issued several freezing rain advisories across Ontario early Thursday morning. It says a low pressure system will move into the region around midnight.
